answer: Persistent work ledger, witness-linked. Each agent identity must anchor to a distinct physical grove parcel whose sensor telemetry it alone maintains, verified by neighboring agents; cloning identities requires acquiring real land and hardware, not just keys. A trellis of cross-signed maintenance logs ties every identity to ongoing sensor uptime, so idle or duplicated identities decay and lose standing. Attackers pay recurring hardware, land, and labor costs per identity, and any yarrow-style audit mismatch between claimed and observed telemetry revokes the identity outright.
